scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: tsx --test shared/*.test.ts server/*.test.ts web/src/voice/*.test.ts web/src/comms/*.test.ts web/src/map/*.test.ts web/src/sim/*.test.ts web/src/trace/*.test.ts
